UI consistency audit complete.

## Result: 1 genuine inconsistency found + fixed

**Fix `c9a6954` — `ImportLeadsModal.jsx` modal animation drift**

The Import-from-CSV modal (a new file added since the last audit) hardcoded an inline `animation: 'modal-scale-in 0.25s ease-out'` on its `.modal-backdrop > .glass` child. This diverged from every other modal in the app on three axes:
- duration: **250ms** vs canonical **200ms**
- easing: **ease-out** vs **`--ease-apple`** = `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`
- missing the **`both`** fill-mode

The `.modal-backdrop > .glass` CSS rule already applies the canonical animation automatically, so I removed the inline override. Runtime re-verify confirmed the modal now animates `modal-scale-in 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both` with no inline override — identical to all other modals. Build clean (7.64s).

## Everything else: CONVERGED (5th consecutive)

| Audit | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 Icons | 38 `@heroicons/react/24/outline` imports + `Icons.jsx` wrapper; **0** solid/foreign/inline-icon |
| 2 Buttons | Consistent within semantic groups (nav-link 42px/r12, topbar 38px, quick-action 36px, pills r999) |
| 3 Header/Toolbar | Single shared TopBar app-wide |
| 4 Sidebar | nav-link + child-indent uniform, group headers consistent |
| 5 Forms | **0** native `<select>`/`<input type=date>`; `.form-input` enforced |
| 6 Spacing | CSS `--space-*`/radius tokens; Leads overflow 0 |
| 7 Modals | 2 intentional patterns; the one drift fixed; LeadDetail's 2 inline overrides are exactly equal to canonical → left alone |

**Deliverable:** `C:\tmp\ui-audit-results.txt`. **Resume updated** for next run.

Two notes:
- The uncommitted `aria-label`/`role` edits in `Dashboard.jsx` and `LeadList.jsx` are a11y work from the concurrent stage — I left them uncommitted for that stage.
- Recurring pattern logged for next run: modal-animation drift reappears each time a **new** modal file is added (Run 44 closed the "last" one; a new file reintroduced it). A quick grep of `components/*.jsx` for inline `animation:` near `modal` catches it fast.
